composition_subtypes.role: sort items descending and greedily select weight-3 items; order weight-1,2 for DP
DP over capacity using sorted weight-1 and weight-2 items

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort items by cost descending; DP over capacity with weight-1,2 items in sorted order; then greedy addition of weight-3 items.
payload.rationale: DP for weights 1 and 2 uses sorted greedy order; weight-3 handled by greedy prefix sum; combined to maximise total cost.
